description: React component for managing and displaying financial transactions including listing recent transactions and creating new double-entry journal entries.

methods.name: TransactionsPage
methods.description: Main React functional component for handling transactions CRUD and display.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Fetches transactions and accounts data from APIs.

methods.name: updateLine
methods.description: Updates a specific line in the transaction entry form.

methods.name: addLine
methods.description: Adds a new blank line for transaction entry.

methods.name: removeLine
methods.description: Removes a specific line from transaction entries.

methods.name: createTransaction
methods.description: Validates and submits a new transaction to the server, then resets form.
